required_for_unsupported_identities: First identify an exact original publisher article and obtain source-specific reuse/extent evidence within a separately authorized bounded scope. Social/video/homepage/media tokens are not articles; never rewrite an alias into an unexposed identity without reservation.
required_for_history_holds: Provide saved source-only evidence separating an actual named weather episode, physical asset or reporting chain from already exposed components. Different dates, districts, wording or article identifiers alone do not clear a relationship. Otherwise retain the hold.
required_for_reference_holds: Source-contained explicit type and sense for the place, a coherent location-bearing original mixed passage, and supported original extent. Unknown references stay unscored.
required_for_language_holds: An unchanged original passage with Filipino clauses and untranslated English common or technical material, plus a complete six-class positive location; English-only reports and names alone do not fill the remaining Taglish quota.
required_for_metadata_holds: An exact complete supported original article identity and publication evidence before capture; snippet fragments or ambiguous tokens alone do not qualify.
